backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a developer portfolio backend, defining types and CRUD operations for skills, projects, experiences, social links, contact messages, and admin authentication with session management, resume, and avatar file storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two features: creating a reusable QRCode React component using the qr-code-styling library, and updating QrPage.tsx to use that component with styled options matching the portfolio's color theme.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, covering pages, hooks, components, and layouts in the portfolio application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, accent, sidebar, chart colors, etc.) used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title, meta description, and Open Graph/Twitter card tags for Bajrangi Yadav's developer portfolio.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers on public routes while disallowing the /admin path, and pointing to the sitemap location.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing the portfolio's public URLs (home, about, skills, projects, experience, contact, create) with change frequencies and priorities.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that configures TanStack Router with all public routes (home, about, skills, projects, experience, contact, create, scan, qr, scanner) and admin routes, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Full-screen access denied UI component displaying a shield alert icon, an explanatory message, and a button to return to the home page.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminEmailL: Renders an admin email/password login form that authenticates via useAdminSession, handles error normalization, and redirects to the intended admin path on success.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: A button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout, toggling authentication state and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/controls/DarkMod: A ghost icon button that toggles between light and dark themes using next-themes.
Animates a cycling list of words with a typewriter effect (typing and deleting), respecting the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AdminLayo: Provides the authenticated admin shell with a sidebar nav, header, and logout button; redirects unauthenticated users to the AdminEmailLoginForm.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders a simple site footer with a copyright notice and a branded caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/PublicLay: Wraps public pages with the PublicNavbar, Footer, and SEO head manager using a TanStack Router Outlet.
frontend/src/components/layout/PublicNav: Responsive navigation bar with desktop links and a collapsible mobile menu, highlighting the active route and including a dark mode toggle.
frontend/src/components/projects/Project: Displays a single project as a card with an optional image, description, technology badges, and links to a live demo and GitHub repo.
frontend/src/components/shared-assets/qr: Re-exports the QRCode component and its TypeScript types from the QRCode module.
frontend/src/components/shared-assets/QR: Lazily loads the qr-code-styling CDN library and renders a styled, configurable QR code SVG into a container div.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an anonymous or authenticated actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGuard.ts: Thin wrapper around useAdminSession that exposes authentication and loading state for guarding admin routes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Provides React Query mutation hooks for CRUD operations on projects, skills, experiences, social links, and other portfolio data, with consistent unauthorized-error handling and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching contact messages and the current caller's user profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Manages admin session state using a module-level token store backed by localStorage, exposing login/logout mutations and session validation via React Query.
Provides a React Query mutation hook for submitting a contact form message to the backend actor, with success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useInitializeSeed.ts: On mount, checks if the caller is an admin and, if so, calls the backend initialize method to seed data, then invalidates all queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortfolioQueries.t: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all public portfolio data (about, skills, projects, experiences, social links, resume, and avatar) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme tokens, base styles, a typing-caret blink animation, and a text-balance utility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays the About Me page with an avatar image, bio text, and summary cards for experience and focus, fetching data via portfolio query hooks with skeleton loading states.
Admin page for editing the About section content via a textarea form, loading existing content on mount and saving updates via a mutation.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminAvatarPage: Admin page for uploading and previewing a profile avatar image, with file type/size validation, upload progress tracking, and display of the current avatar.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard landing page that renders a grid of navigation cards linking to each admin management section (Projects, Skills, About, Experience, Social Links, Messages, Resume, Avatar).
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminExperience: Admin page for managing work experience entries with create, edit, and delete operations via dialogs and alert dialogs, backed by corresponding mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMessagesPa: Admin page that lists contact form submissions sorted by date, allowing admins to mark messages as read or delete them with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProjectsPa: Admin page for managing portfolio projects with full CRUD operations, using a dialog form for create/edit and an alert dialog for delete confirmations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminResumePage: Admin page for uploading and managing the portfolio resume PDF, with file validation, upload progress tracking, and a download option for the current resume.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSkillsPage: Admin page for managing skills with CRUD operations, displaying skills in a table and using a dialog form with category and level selectors.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSocialLink: Admin page for managing social media links with CRUD operations, displaying links in a table and using a dialog form for platform and URL input.
frontend/src/pages/BarcodePage.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders a contact form with name, email, and message fields with validation, and displays social links fetched from the portfolio API alongside form submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePage.tsx: Landing/services page featuring a hero section, a list of three service cards (Web Dev, Full Stack, Blockchain), and up to three featured projects fetched from the portfolio API.
frontend/src/pages/ExperiencePage.tsx: Displays a vertical timeline of professional experience entries fetched from the portfolio API, showing title, company, location, dates, and description with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Hero landing page with an animated typing headline, brief bio, and action buttons for viewing projects, contacting, and downloading a resume (with fallback to a static PDF).
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Renders a responsive grid of all portfolio projects fetched via a query hook, showing skeleton placeholders while loading and a fallback empty state message.
frontend/src/pages/QrPage.tsx: Displays a styled QR code page that encodes the portfolio URL, with a direct link button and instructions for scanning, using a shared QRCode component.
frontend/src/pages/ScannerPage.tsx: A QR code scanner page that uses the camera to scan QR codes and redirects to a specific portfolio URL when a matching code is detected, with states for idle, scanning, success, and unrecognized codes.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: Immediately redirects the user to the portfolio URL via window.location.replace on mount, showing a spinner and redirect message in the meantime.
frontend/src/pages/SkillsPage.tsx: Displays portfolio skills grouped by category (Backend, Frontend, Deployment & Tools) in a card grid, with loading skeletons while data is fetched.
frontend/src/seo/routeSeo.ts: Defines a static mapping of public portfolio routes to their SEO configurations (title, description, og image) and exports a lookup function to retrieve config by pathname.
frontend/src/seo/SeoHeadManager.tsx: React component that dynamically updates document head meta tags, Open Graph tags, canonical links, and JSON-LD structured data based on the current route, suppressing SEO tags for admin and utility routes.
frontend/src/seo/structuredData.ts: Provides JSON-LD structured data helpers for SEO, generating WebSite and Person schema.org objects for Bajrangi Yadav's portfolio.
frontend/src/utils/adminAuthErrors.ts: Normalizes backend admin authentication error messages into user-friendly strings, sanitizing role/permission-related error details.
frontend/src/utils/adminRedirect.ts: Manages storing, retrieving, and clearing the intended admin path in sessionStorage to support post-login redirects.
frontend/src/utils/motokoOption.ts: Utility to unwrap Motoko/Candid optional values (Some/None shapes) into a normalized T | null TypeScript value.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the design system with oklch-based color tokens, custom border radii, accordion animations, Inter font, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 45) for a full-stack developer portfolio with Laravel/MySQL backend and Vue.js frontend, documenting architectural decisions, known issues, and implemented features.
